args.title: Enable Export button after failed export
args.body: Issue 4192 reports that the Export button remains greyed out following a failed export, such as when the server returns an error. This change aims to ensure that the Export button becomes active again after a failure, allowing users to attempt another export without needing to reload the entire page.
